scanNote:
8-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (56-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida chapda BINAFShA yorliqda oq '8' va 'A Brush with Danger'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Past Perfect Simple (had + past participle)'.
8) 'Study the example and complete the rule.' Ko'k qiya: 'When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what HAD HAPPENED.'
   OCh KO'K quti, oq 'Form/Use': • 'We form the PAST PERFECT SIMPLE with ......... + the ......... PARTICIPLE of the main verb.' Jadval: Affirmative: I/you/he/she/it/we/you/they HAD EATEN. Negative: ... HAD NOT/HADN'T EATEN. Interrogative: HAD I/you/... EATEN? Short answers: Yes, I HAD./No, I HADN'T. etc. • 'We use the past perfect simple to talk about a past action which happened before another past action.' To'q sariq qiya: 'He called Jane AFTER he HAD FINISHED dinner. (First he finished dinner, then he called Jane.)' • 'The past perfect simple is the past equivalent of the present perfect simple.' 'He HAS never TRAVELLED abroad. (present perfect simple)' / 'He HAD never TRAVELLED abroad. (past perfect simple)' Qalin: 'Time expressions used with the past perfect: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before etc.'
9) 'Read the story in Ex. 4 again and find the past perfect simple forms.'
10) Qiya: 'Sheila went on holiday last month. When she returned, she discovered that burglars had broken into her home.' Qalin: 'Look at the pictures, then complete the sentences, as in the example.'
   IKKI SURAT (chizma): 'before' - tartibli xona: stolda kompyuter, deraza butun, javonda kitoblar, devorda rasm, vazada gullar; 'after' - deraza singan, stol ustidagi kompyuter polda, kitoblar poldа sochilgan, vaza singan, gullar polda, seyf ochiq (devorda).
   1 The burglars ... HAD BROKEN ... (break) the window in the study. (ko'k qiya) 2 They ...... (open) the safe. 3 They ...... (steal) the jewellery from inside the safe. 4 They ...... (smash) her favourite vase. 5 They ...... (pull) most of her books out of the bookcase. 6 They ...... (throw) her computer onto the floor.

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Look at the Photo File section and complete the letter Sheila sent to her friend.'
11) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the list of chores for the cleaner, then listen and tick (✓) those which she had done when Mary came home from work. Then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.' O'nta katakchali band: 1 do the laundry 2 do the ironing 3 mop the kitchen floor 4 do the washing-up 5 clean the bathroom 6 vacuum the dining room 7 polish the silver 8 dust the living room 9 clean the windows 10 sweep the garden path. Ko'k qiya namuna: "SA: Had she done the laundry? SB: No, she hadn't."
12) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple.' Besh gap: 1 I ...... (just/finish) the cleaning when Bill ...... (come) round for a cup of coffee. 2 She ...... (never/eat) Thai food before she ...... (go) to Thailand. 3 After Peter ...... (have) a bath, he ...... (read) his paper. 4 They ...... (spend) all their money before they ...... (come) back from their holidays. 5 We ...... (see) the film before we ...... (watch) the play.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '56'.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Perfect Simple (had + past participle) — Form/Use
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT - 8-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAD + 3-ShAKL (past participle)
  ⚠ BARCha shaxsda 'had' - o'zgarmaydi!

  TASDIQ: I/he/they HAD eaten
  INKOR: HADN'T eaten (had not)
  SAVOL: HAD you eaten?
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, I had. /
     No, I hadn't.

  QISQARTMA: I'd, he'd, they'd
  ⚠ "I'd" = 'I had' (past perfect)
  yoki 'I would' - kontekstga qarab:
  "I'd eaten" → had; "I'd like" →
  would.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  O'TMIShDA IKKI VOQEA - qaysi biri
  OLDIN bo'lganini ko'rsatadi:

  'He called Jane AFTER he HAD
   FINISHED dinner.'
  1-voqea: finished dinner (past
     perfect - OLDINGISI)
  2-voqea: called Jane (past
     simple - KEYINGISI)

  ⚠ "O'tmishdan ham oldingi o'tmish"
  deb eslab qoling.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT BILAN ALOQASI   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  present perfect: has/have + 3-shakl
     'He HAS never travelled abroad.'
     (hozirgacha)
  past perfect: had + 3-shakl
     'He HAD never travelled abroad.'
     (o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha)

  ⚠ Past perfect = present perfect
  ning O'TGAN ZAMONI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VAQT SO'ZLARI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  already, by the time, never,
  as soon as, just, after, when,
  before

  ⚠ 'by the time' = ... gacha,
  ... paytga kelib.
  ⚠ 'as soon as' = ... zahoti.


⚠ 'BEFORE' va 'AFTER' BILAN:

  'AFTER he HAD finished, he
   called.' (after + past perfect)
  'BEFORE he called, he HAD
   finished.' (before + past simple,
   asosiy gap past perfect)


⚠ 'EQUIVALENT':

  = ekvivalent, teng.
  ⚠ 'the past equivalent of' =
  ... ning o'tgan zamondagi tengi.

points.en: When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened.
points.uz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi.

points.en: We form the past perfect simple with had + the past participle of the main verb.
points.uz: Past perfect simple ni 'had' + asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Qoidadagi ikki bo'sh joy: HAD, PAST.

points.en: Affirmative: I/you/he/she/it/we/you/they had eaten. Negative: had not / hadn't eaten. Interrogative: Had I/you/... eaten? Short answers: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
points.uz: Tasdiq: ... had eaten. Inkor: hadn't eaten. Savol: Had ... eaten? Qisqa javob: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'had' BARCha shaxsda bir xil.
⚠ 'eat - ate - EATEN'.

points.en: We use the past perfect simple to talk about a past action which happened before another past action.
points.uz: Past perfect simple ni boshqa o'tmish harakatidan OLDIN bo'lgan o'tmish harakati haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Ikki o'tmish voqea - OLDINGISI past perfect.

points.en: He called Jane after he had finished dinner. (First he finished dinner, then he called Jane.)
points.uz: U kechki ovqatni tugatgandan keyin Jeynga qo'ng'iroq qildi. (Avval ovqatni tugatdi, keyin qo'ng'iroq qildi.)

points.en: The past perfect simple is the past equivalent of the present perfect simple.
points.uz: Past perfect simple - present perfect simple ning o'tgan zamondagi tengi.

points.en: He has never travelled abroad. (present perfect simple) / He had never travelled abroad. (past perfect simple)
points.uz: U hech qachon chet elga sayohat qilmagan. (hozirgacha) / U hech qachon chet elga sayohat qilmagan edi. (o'shangacha)

points.en: Time expressions used with the past perfect: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before etc.
points.uz: Past perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before va h.k.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'by the time' = ... paytga kelib.
⚠ 'as soon as' = ... zahoti.

exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi hikoyani qayta o'qing va past perfect simple shakllarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
55-BETDAGI HIKOYaDAN PAST PERFECT:

  'he HAD never SEEN it himself'
  'He HAD just CAST his fishing line
   when ...'
  'couldn't believe what HAD
   HAPPENED'
  'he told the tourists what HAD
   HAPPENED'
  'a scientist who HAD SPENT most of
   her life'
  'the only one who HAD BENEFITTED'


⚠ HAR BIRIDA 'OLDINGI' VOQEA:

  'had never seen' - hikoya
     boshlanishidan oldin
  'had just cast' - qayiq chayqalishidan
     oldin
  'had happened' - aytishdan oldin
  'had spent' - uchrashishdan oldin
  'had benefitted' - hikoya oxirigacha

points.en: had never seen, had just cast, had happened (×2), had spent, had benefitted
points.uz: had never seen, had just cast, had happened (2 marta), had spent, had benefitted

exercises.instructionEn: Sheila went on holiday last month. When she returned, she discovered that burglars had broken into her home. Look at the pictures, then complete the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sheila o'tgan oy ta'tilga ketdi. Qaytganida, uyiga o'g'rilar kirganini bildi. Suratlarga qarang, so'ng namunadagidek gaplarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'BEFORE' va 'AFTER' SURATLARI.

  ⚠ Sheila QAYTGANDA (past simple)
  o'g'rilar allaqachon hamma narsani
  QILIB BO'LGAN EDI (past perfect).


JAVOBLAR:

  1 had broken (namuna)
  2 had opened
  3 had stolen
  4 had smashed
  5 had pulled
  6 had thrown


⚠ 3-ShAKLLAR:

  break - broke - BROKEN
  open - opened - OPENED
  steal - stole - STOLEN
  smash - smashed - SMASHED
  pull - pulled - PULLED
  throw - threw - THROWN


⚠ 'A BURGLAR':

  = o'g'ri (uyga kiradigan).
  ⚠ 'to burgle' = uyni o'g'irlamoq.
  ⚠ 'a thief' - umumiy o'g'ri.


⚠ 'TO BREAK INTO':

  = buzib kirmoq.
  ⚠ 'broke into her home' = uyiga
  buzib kirdi.


⚠ 'A SAFE':

  = seyf (ot).
  ⚠ 'safe' (sifat) = xavfsiz.


⚠ 'JEWELLERY':

  = zargarlik buyumlari.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'jewellery', AQShda
  'jewelry'.


⚠ 'TO SMASH':

  = chil-chil sindirmoq.


⚠ 'A STUDY':

  = ish xonasi (uyda).
  ⚠ 'o'qish' emas!

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - qaysi ishlar
bajarilgani faqat yozuvdan.


O'N YuMUSh:

  1 do the laundry - kir yuvmoq
  2 do the ironing - dazmol qilmoq
  3 mop the kitchen floor - oshxona
    polini yuvmoq
  4 do the washing-up - idish yuvmoq
  5 clean the bathroom - hammomni
    tozalamoq
  6 vacuum the dining room - ovqat
    xonasini changyutgich bilan
    tozalamoq
  7 polish the silver - kumush
    buyumlarni yaltiratmoq
  8 dust the living room - mehmonxona
    changini artmoq
  9 clean the windows - derazalarni
    tozalamoq
  10 sweep the garden path - bog'
    yo'lakchasini supurmoq


⚠ 'A CLEANER':

  = farrosh, tozalovchi.


⚠ 'TO MOP':

  = shvabra bilan yuvmoq.
  ⚠ 'a mop' = shvabra.


⚠ 'TO VACUUM':

  = changyutgich bilan tozalamoq.
  ⚠ 'a vacuum cleaner' = changyutgich.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈvækjuːm/.


⚠ 'TO POLISH':

  = yaltiratmoq.
  ⚠ 'Polish' (KATTA harf) = polyak!


⚠ 'THE SILVER':

  = kumush buyumlar (qoshiq, vilka).


⚠ 'TO SWEEP':

  = supurmoq.
  ⚠ sweep - swept - swept.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past perfect simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYSI VOQEA OLDIN?

  OLDINGI → past perfect
  KEYINGI → past simple


JAVOBLAR:

  1 I HAD JUST FINISHED the cleaning
    when Bill CAME round.
    (avval tozaladi, keyin Bill
     keldi)
  2 She HAD NEVER EATEN Thai food
    before she WENT to Thailand.
    (Tailandga borishdan oldin
     yemagan edi)
  3 After Peter HAD HAD a bath, he
    READ his paper.
    (avval cho'mildi, keyin o'qidi)
  4 They HAD SPENT all their money
    before they CAME back.
    (qaytishdan oldin sarflab
     bo'lgan)
  5 We HAD SEEN the film before we
    WATCHED the play.
    (avval film, keyin spektakl)


⚠ 3-BAND - 'HAD HAD':

  'to have a bath' → 'HAD HAD a bath'
  ⚠ Birinchi 'had' - yordamchi,
  ikkinchisi - asosiy fe'l 3-shakli.
  ⚠ To'g'ri!


⚠ 'BEFORE' bilan:

  X HAD happened BEFORE Y happened.
  ⚠ 'before' dan keyin PAST SIMPLE,
  asosiy gapda PAST PERFECT.


⚠ 'AFTER' bilan:

  AFTER X HAD happened, Y happened.
  ⚠ 'after' dan keyin PAST PERFECT.


⚠ 'TO COME ROUND':

  = uyga kelmoq (mehmonga).


⚠ 'A PLAY':

  = spektakl (teatr).
  ⚠ 'to watch a play' = spektakl
  ko'rmoq.

items.textEn: 1 I ___ (just/finish) the cleaning when Bill ___ (come) round for a cup of coffee.
items.whyUz:
⚠ OLDINGI: 'had just finished' (past perfect).
⚠ KEYINGI: 'came' (past simple).

items.textEn: 2 She ___ (never/eat) Thai food before she ___ (go) to Thailand.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'had never eaten' - borishdan OLDIN.
⚠ 'before she WENT' - past simple.

items.textEn: 3 After Peter ___ (have) a bath, he ___ (read) his paper.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'after' + past perfect: 'HAD HAD' (ikki 'had'
- to'g'ri!).
⚠ 'read' o'tgan zamon /red/.

items.textEn: 4 They ___ (spend) all their money before they ___ (come) back from their holidays.
5 We ___ (see) the film before we ___ (watch) the play.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'had seen' - OLDINGI (see - saw - SEEN).
⚠ 'before we WATCHED' - past simple.

patterns.explanationUz:

perfect.

patterns.exampleEn: I had just finished the cleaning when Bill came round.
patterns.exampleUz: Tozalashni endigina tugatgan edim, Bill keldi.

patterns.formula: Had [ega] + 3-ShAKL? - Yes, she had. / No, she hadn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Had she done the laundry? - No, she hadn't.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Past perfect savol va qisqa javob.
